cards.headline: Refining & Downstream leads, Grid, Storage & Electrification lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Refining & Downstream at +2.23%; weakest is Grid, Storage & Electrification at -3.56%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.body: Leaders: LNG +3.04%, PSX +2.94%, FTI +2.61%, EQNR +2.47%, XOM +2.33%. Laggards: CCJ -9.85%, UUUU -8.08%, BE -7.42%, OKLO -6.98%.
